prOriginal.nota: Known from earlier check, reconfirmed: compare 060cda77...main = ahead (ancestor of main); committed directly to master 2015-01-05, no PR. Merged code is the benchmark head.

fix-proper-handling-of-group-memberships.reason: The raw-id association delete survived 1c545d4c1e (2015-02-25, became group.users.delete(user.id)) and the move of remove_member from Admin::GroupsController to GroupsController in 6dd4bc7d57 (2015-11-10). PR #4592 'FEATURE: Group logs' (merged 2016-12-12) replaced group.users.delete(user.id) with group.remove(user), which destroys group_users where(user:) and is a no-op for a non-member, so the RecordNotFound path is gone. The change was made to add logging, not aimed at the bug; today remove_member delegates to GroupMemberRemover and the admin action no longer exists.

astra.pergunta: Status for the raw-id delete replaced incidentally by group.remove(user) in the Group logs PR?
The descontinuado definition covers rewrites that remove the behaviour without targeting the bug; does that apply?
astra.resposta: Yes, by the more specific definition the swap was a logic change not aimed at the bug; milestone 05f55dbc10, PR #4592, 2016-12-12.
